'''Matthew Holloman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Sea Girt tournament]] on 1 July 2000 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Coruscant deck]], according to Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d959">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-sea-girt-nj-7-01-00d959/ sea-girt-nj-7-01-00], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-sea-girt-nj-7-01-00d959/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
